payload.title: Admins configure the publication's content shapes in Administration
payload.description: As a publication admin, I configure the list of content shapes in the newsroom Administration (alongside Policies and Sections): add, rename, reorder, retire, and edit each shape's attributes (description, typical length, shelf life, pinnable, own page or not, default sections, writer and classifier guidance, board color/icon). Changes take effect on the board without a deploy. Retiring a shape keeps existing stories readable. Acceptance: CRUD in Administration, editor read access, admin write access, audit fields like other Administration records.
